story.iWant: to enter an immersive dark-themed configurator environment with a responsive layout
story.soThat: the marble cube stands out beautifully and I feel like I'm in a private atelier where I can design my custom creation

tasks.task: Implement mobile layout with bottom sheet

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Configurator page displays full Nero Marquina dark theme (bg: #0D0D0D, surface: #1A1A1A, text: #FFFFFF/#B3B3B3, accent: #C9A962)
Desktop layout follows 70/30 split (3D viewport 70%, config panel 30%, min-height 600px viewport)
Mobile layout uses top/bottom structure (60% viewport, 40% bottom sheet, swipeable/draggable)
Minimal header with logo and back navigation (returns to previous page, logo links to homepage)
Page title updates dynamically (reflects current marble selection, meta description for SEO)
3D canvas area prepared for React Three Fiber integration (placeholder with shimmer loading, ready for Story 3.3)
Configuration panel structure with placeholder sections (MarbleSelector, DimensionInputs, FinishPicker, PriceDisplay)
Accessibility requirements met (aria-labels, focus management, keyboard navigation, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast)

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Users can access 3D configurator from homepage or gallery. All configurator changes update 3D view in real-time (<500ms). NFR1-6 define performance targets: 3D load <3s, 60fps, changes <500ms.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: All configurator components in src/components/configurator/. PascalCase components. Use existing UI primitives from shadcn/ui. Server Components for data, Client for interactivity.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.section: 3.1 Color System - Nero Marquina, 8.1 Responsive Strategy
doc.snippet: Nero Marquina theme: bg #0D0D0D, surface #1A1A1A, accent #C9A962, text #FFFFFF. Desktop: 70% cube, 30% config panel. Mobile: 60% viewport, bottom sheet 40% swipeable.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story 3.1 establishes configurator shell with dark theme, responsive layout, and placeholder structure for subsequent stories (3.3-3.8).

doc.title: Story 2-6 Completed
doc.snippet: Created ConfiguratorClient.tsx with dark theme class, configStore.ts with persist middleware, theme-transition-cinematic animation. Placeholder UI marked for Epic 3 replacement.

interface.name: ConfiguratorClientProps
interface.signature: interface ConfiguratorClientProps { initialMarble: string; marbleName?: string; }

interface.name: ConfigState
interface.signature: interface ConfigState { marbleSlug: string; width: number; height: number; depth: number; finish: FinishType; _hasHydrated: boolean; }

interface.name: ConfigActions
interface.signature: interface ConfigActions { setMarble, setDimensions, setWidth, setHeight, setDepth, setFinish, initializeFromUrl, reset, setHasHydrated }

constraints.constraint: Extend ConfiguratorClient, do not replace. Compose new components within existing structure.
All new configurator components go in src/components/configurator/
Follow existing naming conventions: PascalCase components, camelCase utilities
Use existing Tailwind tokens and CSS variables from globals.css
Responsive: use Tailwind breakpoints (md: for desktop ≥768px)
Dark theme already applied via .dark class - leverage existing tokens
WCAG 2.1 AA compliance required per NFR13-17
No loading spinners - use shimmer skeleton states per UX spec
All text must use next-intl translations, extend "configurator" namespace
No E2E tests from 2-6 - consider adding Playwright tests for this story

tests.standards: Use Vitest for unit/component tests, Playwright for E2E. Test files co-located or in tests/ directory. Follow existing patterns from codebase.

ideas.idea: Test dark theme CSS variables are applied correctly on configurator route

Test mobile layout renders stacked with bottom sheet at viewport <768px
Test bottom sheet expand/collapse on swipe gesture
Test back button navigates to previous page (gallery or marble detail)
Test page title updates with marble name dynamically
Test 3D placeholder renders with shimmer animation
Test all placeholder sections render (MarbleSelector, DimensionInputs, FinishPicker, PriceDisplay)
Test keyboard navigation through panel controls (Tab, Enter, Arrow keys)
Run Lighthouse accessibility audit, verify score ≥90
